name: The Office
source:
You are a young guy who recently got a new job. You are late on your first day at work. Your boss is very unhappy with this. Fuck your boss in her own house and even in the office!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一个刚找到新工作的年轻人，却在上班第一天迟到了，女上司对此十分不满。在她家里，甚至在办公室里，与她上床吧！

[摘编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003620/]Steam[/url]]
